A_shop_unlock_distribution.note: Individual draws are iid uniform(1/8). Per-type seasonal counts are only weakly negatively correlated because the total number of unlocks is fixed at 8.

F_product_ranking.note: Demand-side risk only (town consumption). Products no shop consumes (e.g. MELON) have a deterministic drain path, so zero price variance ranks them top here; opponent overproduction risk (sq/linear glut curves) is NOT captured for them.
